name: rni
description: RNI — Répertoire National des Négociateurs (monorepo pnpm : Angular + NestJS)

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db
scripts.release: pnpm build && rm -rf release && pnpm --filter @rni/api deploy --prod --legacy release/api && cp -r apps/web/dist/web/browser release/web
scripts.docker:up: docker compose up -d --build db api web
scripts.db:migrate: for f in apps/api/db/migrations/*.sql; do echo "→ $f"; docker exec -i rni-db psql -U rni -d rni -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q < "$f" || exit 1; done
